posts.title: My exercise masks a shit diet
posts.description: I struggle to eat healthily. Luckily, my exercise hides and compensates for the shit I eat. On top of that, I use exercise as an excuse to eat more shit. According to the NHS website my BMI of 23.7 is in the "Healthy" range. (I know BMI is not a great indicator for actual health. This post is kind of on that topic.) posts.title: Our families got pets and now we can't visit any of them
posts.description: My girlfriend is allergic to cats and dogs. Calling her my "girlfriend" feels a bit childish. She's my "partner". We're in out thirties, and have been together since we were teenagers. That whole time, she has known, and made no secret about, the fact that she is allergic to cats and dogs.
